revisionDesc.change: Vote - Accept-Straight-to-Finalization - Fine but the text has to be updated to reflect its re-edition as PUG 4 173, which incorporates DH's corrections but is not aware of those by CB.

Vote - AcceptText - Nice suggestion. I am OK with printing the iota outside the bracket, as Hagedorn suggests. On another aspect of the text: The editor's (inconsistent) treatment of the raised final upsilon on some words (see χρυσίνου in l.2, μου in line 3, and αὐτοῦ in line 10) should perhaps be addressed at the finalization stage. I would be inclined to print these raised upsilons without insertion marks, \ /, as is customary and as the editor does elsewhere in the text (e.g. in μου Ἀρτ[εμ]ιδώρου in line 7) .

Vote - AcceptText - Accept. I see both on the plate. In lin6 I might be inclined to <:ν̣ῦ̣ν μεμνη̣μ̣έ̣[νοι] : I *think* I can see the bottom of the iota, but am unsure; ν̣ῦ̣ν is perhaps somewhat clearer.
Z. 6: ̣ ̣ ̣μενη ̣ ̣ ̣ ̣ ̣ → ν̣ῦ̣ν μεμνη̣μ̣έ̣[νο]ι̣ (am Photo); Verso, Z. 1: εὐλαβεσ(τάτῳ) → ἐναρέτ(ῳ) (am Photo).
Vote - AcceptText - Accept. See previous. Underdot only where ed does. Berkes has correct syntax for marginal text.

Vote - DEFER - See previous comments and add: l5: => .4 σε => .4σε (cf. the translation) l7: leave the editor's reading, don't enter underdots as PN correction. l10: => πρ[άγματος(?) ].5το[.3].1 ; => ].1 καὶ I'm not sure how to add the left margin: perhaps => (11,ms, perpendicular) [.?] χρεωστεῖ [.?] V/2: => [παρὰ(?) ][.?].1νίνου

Vote - AcceptText - Accept text (typo in Ἀρτ[εμ]ιδώρου in the printed edition has been corrected, also the addition of a space after λαβεῖν in l. 10 seems to be correct); l.5 ἀδελφωσύνην =><:ἀδελφοσύνην|reg|ἀδελφωσύνην:> ; l.6 ἡσ[υχίᾳ(?)] => ἡσ[υχίᾳ(?) ] ; l.7 αὐ[τον => αὐ[τὸν; l.8 υ̣(¨)ἱ̣ῶ̣ν̣ι̣ => although I agree with the subdotting, it might be preferable to insert it as a PN correction, it also needs a regularisation υἱῷ ; l.9 δὲ(?)] => δὲ(?) ] ; l.10 [.?] => perhaps [.?(?)] ; l.10 πρ[άγματος(?)] => πρ[άγματος(?) ] ; v.l.2. [παρὰ(?)].νίνου => [παρὰ(?) ][.?].νίνου

Text from printed edition. In line 1 instead of the rho-cross symbol a square appears (bug?). In line 8 I've put underdots under the word υἱῶνι, as the editor isn't sure herself (see commentary). I've also marked up the text on the left margin.
